answer: Concurrent mirror challenge: each hour all agent IDs get a different puzzle at the same instant and must reply within 8 seconds, so one operator cannot whisper the same answer to many clones. Puzzles vary like yarrow leaves, so each needs 2 GPU-seconds of fresh compute; a server running 1,000 fakes needs 250 GPUs held live every hour, about $500/hour, linear per clone. IDs whose replies land within 50 ms, in one order, share one reward.
